2122525453256941732.en_summary: Benchmark's Bill Gurley says AI deal terms "got too far" and the data suggests the spending boom probably went up to the edge. "You shouldn't be able to use your balance sheet to drive your income statement". "I don't think it's Nvidia specific because I think Google did it, and Amazon did it, and Microsoft did it". Points to hyperscalers using up free cash flow, moving into debt and off balance sheet commitments, rising neocloud borrowing costs and stretched receivables at $NVDA, which reports earnings tomorrow ($GOOGL $AMZN $MSFT $META). Gurley isn't asking if it unwinds, he's asking how fast. via @YahooFinance, featuring @bgurley
2122525453256941732.zh_summary: Benchmark的Bill Gurley說AI交易條款「走得太遠」，數據顯示支出熱潮可能已到邊緣。「你不應該能夠使用資產負債表來驅動損益表」。 「我不認為這是Nvidia特有的，因為我認為Google做了，Amazon做了，Microsoft也做了」。指出超大規模企業用儘自由現金流，轉向債務和表外承諾，新雲借貸成本上升，以及 $NVDA 應收帳款拉伸，該公司明天公布業績（$GOOGL $AMZN $MSFT $META）。Gurley不是問是否會回調，而是問多快。透過 @YahooFinance， featuring @bgurley
